basic_info.description: 👋 I'm Apampa Mardiyyah, a final-year Computer Science student at Pan-Atlantic University with strong experience in full-stack software development. I have worked with both relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL and MongoDB. I build scalable, user-focused applications. My academic and practical interests lie at the intersection of software engineering, Artificial Intelligence, robotics, and Human–Computer Interaction (HCI). I am currently working on my final-year project in HCI, which focuses on the design of a voice-controlled robot interface for people with limited mobility, applying core HCI principles to improve accessibility, usability, and human–robot interaction. My long-term goal is to build intelligent, human-centered AI and robotic systems that solve real-world problems. I am highly motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning and impactful innovation.

projects.title: Social Networking Platform
projects.description: This project is a social networking web application developed as a work task for triBBBal LLC. The platform supports core social features such as user interactions through follow and unfollow functionality, event creation and management, and real-time chat. It also incorporates AJAX-based interactions to enable dynamic content updates without page reloads, improving responsiveness and user experience. The project emphasizes scalable design, real-time communication, and efficient user engagement within a modern web application.

projects.title: PayVantage Dashboard
projects.description: Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard during my internship at PayVantage to visualize and analyze key metrics, including completed transactions, successful transactions, network performance, and response rates, providing actionable insights for the company's daily operations.
